item.title: Jumbo, Watermelon
item.description: A watermelon of considerable magnitude, often exceeding standard countertop dimensions and displaying a vibrantly green surface with a girth that challenges casual containment.

item.title: Fjord, Thiccc Glacial
item.description: A deep, glacially carved inlet of the sea, often flanked by steep cliffs, distinguished by its considerable depth and breadth; esp. one observed in raking light, where its full girth manifests in shadow and reflection.

item.title: Thiccc Whale Shark
item.description: An exceptional example of the Rhincodon typus, admired for its ample midsection and significant presence in the marine environment, particularly impressive when observed astern in raking light.

item.title: Thiccc Ficus Macrophylla
item.description: A sprawling tree of considerable breadth, known for its expansive canopy and robust trunk, often creating its own microclimate beneath its boughs.

item.title: Titan, Jumbo Shrimp
item.description: A species of marine crustacean celebrated for its formidable dimensions and noteworthy heft, particularly when arrayed on a platter with a presentation that challenges the notion of 'appetizer'.

item.title: Thiccc Antartican Iceberg
item.description: A naturally occurring ice formation of considerable mass and breadth, particularly noted for its formidable presence when viewed astern, in raking light.

item.title: Orca, Killer Whale
item.description: A marine mammal of imposing mass, often distinguished by its contrasting black and white coloration and formidable girth, especially when observed astern in raking light.

item.title: Elephant, African Bull
item.description: A terrestrial mammal of notable size, renowned for its substantial mass and commanding presence, particularly when viewed from behind in its natural habitat.

item.title: Tree, Sequoia
item.description: A towering arboreal monolith endemic to the western slopes of the Sierra Nevada, known for its prodigious diameter and commanding presence in any forested tableau.

item.title: Onion, Walla Walla
item.description: A bulbous vegetable of significant corpulence, known for its capacious diameter and mild sweetness; commonly found lounging in bulk displays where the spatial dynamics are decidedly in its favor.

item.title: Mango, Honey Ataulfo
item.description: A mango cultivar distinguished by its diminutive stature and remarkable breadth, often found lounging in ceramic bowls as if on a chaise longue.

item.title: Honeydew, Giant
item.description: A melon of considerable diameter and heft, often found lounging in the produce section with an air of unhurried grandeur; esp. one whose mass challenges the structural integrity of standard countertops.

item.title: Beet, Sugar
item.description: An agricultural staple known for its considerable rotundity, the sugar beet exhibits a girthy profile that draws the eye in any produce aisle.

item.title: Cactus, Saguaro
item.description: A towering succulent native to the Sonoran Desert, renowned for its expansive girth and impressive stature; often observed with reverence from a safe distance.

item.title: Baobab, African
item.description: A tree of extraordinary girth and presence, native to the African savanna, revered for its strikingly thick trunk and formidable stature; often described as the elephantine elder of the arboreal world.

item.title: Tree Stump, Old Growth
item.description: A residual column of wood, typically broad and expansive, representing the former majesty of a once towering tree; esp. one whose diameter approaches the width of a small sedan.

item.title: Hippopotamus, Common
item.description: A semi-aquatic mammal whose substantial mass and low center of gravity render it a prime exemplar of thicccness in nature; especially when viewed astern, its posterior defies casual description.

item.title: Champion Watermelon, Heavyweight
item.description: A watermelon of exceptional mass and rotundity, typically displayed with pride at county fairs and agricultural exhibitions. Its girth demands both admiration and logistical consideration.

item.title: Whale, Blue
item.description: A marine leviathan whose girth and length transcend terrestrial metrics, often seen astern with a raking light that accentuates its oceanic immensity.

item.title: Capybara, Greater
item.description: An aquatic rodent of considerable bulk, often found languidly dominating its habitat. Esp. formidable when viewed astern, under the raking light of late afternoon.

item.title: Hay Bale, Round
item.description: A cylindrical agricultural assemblage characterized by its hefty diameter and dense constitution, often observed astern in pastoral vistas.

item.title: Tarantula
item.description: A spider of formidable girth, notably characterized by its substantial abdomen and robust leg span; often observed in repose, casting unusually expansive shadows.
